Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.view

Class ViewFacade

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.view.ViewFacade
public class ViewFacade extends Object
Class that represents the view facade in the application. Provides access to the main window and ensures that there is only one instance of the view through the Singleton pattern.
Author:
Bustamante Castellanos Caren Sofia, Hospital Herrera Dylan Mathyus, Ramirez Chacon Alejandra Valenttina, Ruiz Cruz Gabriel Alejandro, Triana Mejia Juan Diego, Vela Cardozo German Octavio
